data.description:
**3D Coverage Everywhere**

- Almost every recognizable city on earth is available in True 3D, even my tiny hometown in a poor side of Romania is covered, so you are likely able to visit your own street in Immersive 3D

**Street View**

- Best UNCOMPRESSED 8k Quality on the market, with every street 360 and community panorama on Earth

**Multiplayer**

- Explore alongside your friends

**ChatGPT Integration: The AI companion can**

- Naturally respond in YOUR OWN Language
- Visualize & understand your surroundings on Earth for any educational purpose or to simply give fun facts
- Teleport you anywhere on earth when asked
- .. and much more

**Realistic Graphics**

- Real Life Inspired Lighting based on the Customizable Day/Night Cycle
- Realistic, Reactive Fog Option

**Hand Tracking**

- Fly like a Superhero by pointing your index finger
- Rotate by doing a "Steering" gesture with your own hands

**Terrain Quality**

- The 3D Map Quality can go much further than anything else out there and achieve realistic 3D by pushing the map quality to extreme detail with the best possible performance

**Comfort Settings**

- Comfort Options ( Snap Turning / Flight Vignette ) to prevent Motion Sickness
- Flight Input Remapping ( Flight Controls Range from Simple to Complex Cinematic Movement )

**Google Maps Integration**

- Smart / manual zoom based on altitude
- Paired with the compass for body orientation
- Full Google Maps functionality on the Map Window feature

**.. out of space, check "earthquest.site" ..**

-
v41 is RELEASED !

Didn't expect it so soon did ya ?

# AI Controller Hotkey

- Effortlessly use AI with no countdown or menu interaction !

- Properly integrated, cannot be accidentally triggered, and offers introductory visual explanation on how to use

# AI Improvements

- AI Visualization now utilizes 3.29x more resolution ( 228% more quality )

- AI can now properly visualize your perspective in Space

- Fixed seeing Markdown Syntax ( ** ) in AI responses

- If the AI usage limit every few hours wasn’t already generous, now it’s even higher / harder to reach !

# Additional

- A considerate amount of polishing, behavior refinement for better reliability, and bug fixes.

- Wind will no longer be heard when flying with Flight Speed 0.1x 

- Careful small refinements made to Thumbstick Smooth Rotation, preventing accidentally turning when the Thumbstick is tilted very slightly. Additionally resulting in more responsive 'Thumbstick Flight Input Mode' controls.

- FINALLY Solved the rare, mysterious crash that happened immediately after loading in.  ( I'm 95% sure it's fixed, if it ever happens to you again, let me know )

- Improved Street View nearby 360 detection and usage

Let me know if there are any issues, big OR small ( contact.earthquest.site )

-
v40 is LIVE !

This is a major one.

Introducing...
# Haptic Feedback across the Entirety of EarthQuest !

- Physically feel EarthQuest's User Interface, completing the missing piece in the long-standing goal of MAXIMUM Immersion !

# Additional big improvements

- Improved GPU Performance - Potentially much higher framerates all around 

- Better Immersive Mode Sunsets / Sunrises

- Reintegrated the Controller Input Scheme, ( from How to Play ); — now only displaying the selected Flight Input Mode in larger size, eliminating unnecessary elements and significantly improving readability

- Fixed part of 'Preferences' and Map UI being obstructed by the Menu Button when using Left Handed Mode, everything should now be visible & clear in every scenario !
^ Left-handed users, feedback would be really helpful !

- Reworked the Sun / Moon light casting system, in order to solve some related bugs and for more realism

- Better Keyboard typing sound ( dynamic, less repetitive )

- Freer memory allocation, offering even more stability when using apps in the background 

- More Flight Speed flexibility, now with even slower speed capacity, offering the ability to experience human walking speeds

Let me know if there are any issues, big OR small ( contact.earthquest.site )

v37 Released !

Introducing a game-changing new feature that offers

BETTER 3D Map Quality

Yup, you heard that right, this seemed impossible to work on standalone mobile VR due to the immense computation needed for this type of task

And it was, almost impossible, but with many advanced optimization methods I'm happy to announce that 
EarthQuest manages to do this with the same fluid performance as before !

Additional

- 'Preferences' redesign ! 

- MASSIVE Improvement to movement freedom and fluidity when colliding with 3D surfaces.

- 3D Map Quality and Loading settings will now provide a single, compact, more useful Performance Warning guiding you while adjusting your preferred Quality & Performance

- AI Voice Recording is now more reliable and should now last until completely stopped talking

- You can now switch from the largest Player Scale to Human-Scale & vice versa, IN JUST ONE PRESS !

- Fully supported DMS coordinate format for loading coordinates via 'Search for Place'

--

v37.52:

Polished a broad range of additions from v35-v37 versions and more.

Update now to get the most stable and satisfying experience yet in every aspect. 

--
let me know ( contact.earthquest.site )
if you encounter anything that you may think isn't intended !

v36.5 Released !

Polishing
- Solved 'Search For Place' coordinate loading stutter, it is now smooth like every other function

- Atmospheric new music track

- Many other smaller improvements ( Functionality & UI ) and polish

Big Improvements
- Street View 'Community Imagery' Toggle  -  in 'Preferences'

- GUARANTEED 90 FPS Average in EVERY Loaded Street View thanks to significant optimization !

See the full list of changes on discord ( earthquest.site )
-
v36.00, the version that expands upon all the previous limitations, and which adds one of the most requested feature of all time, is OUT NOW !

Multiplayer with up to not 3, BUT 4 Simultaneous Players !!!!

- Let the adventures begin in 3x, and 4x the fun !!!
- Maximally optimized the entirety of the Multiplayer Core System for maximum performance no matter the amount of players
- Redesigned the Multiplayer Interface, highlighting the current Player’s visible ID, dynamic player list to select which user to teleport to, and room code, all with a new compact & intuitive design with simple & clear visibility
- Only compatible with players on v36 and future versions

The Flight Speed Adjustment System has been reworked to ensure consistency and best possible experience for every altitude and ground level !!

- Altitude inconsistency is now fixed - Previously flying close to the ground at higher altitudes produced significantly faster acceleration than the optimal 0-700m from sea level, which was frustrating and inconvenient 
- The new system will not only provide the same desired speed adjustments for all altitudes and surfaces, but will also provide a more immersive, natural, and dynamic experience specifically tailored to more favorably adapt the user’s chosen speed.
- The system is also more flexible, allowing a larger flight speed setting range ! ( 0.2x to 3.0x )

Entire Hub User Interface REDESIGN !

- The Main Menu will simply be shown without any other settings or options, for maximum simplicity and ease of use; offering clear, comfortable visibility
- A new panel is introduced specifically designed for Flight Customization Settings, Comfort Options, and Accessibility
- Starting with v36, a quick option that allows resetting app data will now effortlessly allow users to instantly solve any underlying bug / error that may rarely occur within just 2 presses !

Additional

- Updated the Menu Button’s color to reflect EarthQuest’s main color palette, Green-Blue
- Tens of other smaller improvements 

——
Enjoy ❤️
